patterns.note: Asymmetrical section layouts pairing large visuals (images/videos) with concise text blocks, often with the visual element dominating one side of the screen.
Prominent, extra-large sans-serif headings are used for section titles, often centered, creating strong visual anchors and a bold statement.
High-contrast color scheme primarily using black and white, with dark gray as a secondary background and text color, and minimal use of a subtle orange/yellow accent for highlights.
The sticky header navigation transitions from transparent over the hero video to an opaque dark gray background with a subtle shadow upon scrolling past the hero section.
Content sections reveal elements (text, images, cards) with a subtle fade-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging scrolling experience.
Alternating full-width sections between light (white/off-white) and dark (black/dark gray) backgrounds to clearly delineate content blocks and create visual rhythm.

technique_notes: A full-bleed hero section features an auto-playing background video with a subtle dark overlay to ensure text legibility, establishing an immersive first impression.

The primary navigation bar is initially transparent, overlaying the hero video, and then smoothly transitions to an opaque dark gray background with a subtle drop shadow as the user scrolls down the page, becoming a fixed element at the top.

Content within subsequent sections is revealed using scroll-triggered animations, where text blocks, images, and product cards subtly fade and slide upwards into view as their respective sections become visible in the viewport, enhancing engagement.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) with clear, legible body text and occasional uppercase labels for emphasis.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (2-4px) on buttons and cards, with many elements featuring sharp corners for a clean, modern look.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between full-width sections and ample internal spacing within content blocks, contributing to a premium feel.

standout: The site's standout feature is its sophisticated use of full-bleed video and large, impactful typography combined with subtle, scroll-triggered animations. The seamless transition of the sticky navigation and the dramatic reveal of content on scroll create a premium, engaging user experience that feels dynamic without being distracting.
